sourceCards.sourceNote: Mexican word; in other countries it is el maní.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ラクトースフリーの牛乳

sourceCards.sourceNote: Never say un otro: just otro café, otra taza.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I never eat peanuts, I'm allergic.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ピーナッツは絶対に食べません。アレルギーがあります。
まだ注文が決まっていません。
コーヒーをもう一杯お願いします。

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Más leche y menos azúcar, por favor.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: More milk and less sugar, please.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 牛乳を多めに、砂糖は少なめでお願いします。

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I don't want anything else, thanks.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ほかには何もいりません。ありがとうございます。
sourceCards.sourceNote: Spanish uses a double negative: no... nada.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma y Tom desayunan en un café de Oaxaca.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma and Tom are having breakfast at a café in Oaxaca.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマとトムは、オアハカのカフェで朝食をとっています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Emma and Tom are having breakfast at a café in Oaxaca.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Luis
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: El mesero Luis pregunta: ¿Ya están listos?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: The server Luis asks: Are you ready?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 店員のルイスが尋ねます。「ご注文はお決まりですか。」
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Staff member Luis asks: Have you decided on your order?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: まだ決まっていません。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: No como carne y Tom no come lácteos.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: I don't eat meat and Tom doesn't eat dairy products.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 私は肉を食べません。トムは乳製品を食べません。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I don't eat meat. Tom does not eat dairy products.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Tom
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Tom: Nunca como cacahuate, soy alérgico.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Tom: I never eat peanuts, I'm allergic.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ピーナッツは絶対に食べません。アレルギーがあります。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I never eat peanuts. I have an allergy.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Luis
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luis: Voy a preguntar en la cocina si usan nueces o cacahuate.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Luis: I'm going to ask the kitchen if they use nuts or peanuts.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 厨房でナッツ類やピーナッツを使っているか確認します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I will check whether the kitchen uses nuts or peanuts.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Luis
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luis: Los chilaquiles verdes sin crema ni queso no tienen carne ni lácteos.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Luis: The green chilaquiles without cream or cheese have no meat or dairy.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: クリームもチーズも入っていない緑のチラキレスには、肉も乳製品も入っていません。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The green chilaquiles without cream or cheese contain neither meat nor dairy products.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Luis
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Luis: Las tortillas de maíz no tienen gluten.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Luis: The corn tortillas don't have gluten.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: トウモロコシのトルティーヤにはグルテンが入っていません。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: The corn tortillas do not contain gluten.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: Otro café con más leche deslactosada y menos azúcar, por favor.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Another coffee with more lactose-free milk and less sugar, please.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: コーヒーをもう一杯。ラクトースフリーの牛乳を多めに、砂糖は少なめでお願いします。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Another coffee, with more lactose-free milk and less sugar, please.
